question.text: Under SEBI (PIT) Regulations 2015, within what prior period must a person have been associated with a listed company to be considered a 'connected person'?

answer.text: 6 months prior to a concerned transaction

explanation.text: The Logic: The PIT Regulations define connected person as one who is or has been associated with the listed company during the 6 months prior to a concerned transaction. The Trap: 3/12 months or 2 years are incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Same definition appears in XII/VIII exams. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Preserve communication records and access logs for 24 months minimum to defend any look-back review.
